translations.web: Let burning coals fall on them. Let them be thrown into the fire, into miry pits, from where they never rise.
translations.bsb: May burning coals fall on them; may they be thrown into the fire, into the miry pits, never to rise again.
translations.kjv: Let burning coals fall upon them: let them be cast into the fire; into deep pits, that they rise not up again.
translations.asv: Let burning coals fall upon them: Let them be cast into the fire, Into deep pits, whence they shall not rise.
